about: Mitchell Robinson made 29% of playoff free throws (17-of-58); Rick Barry offered to teach him; Robinson called it silly as hell; ends on Shaq's 'Thanks, but no thanks.'
name: Why won't big men shoot underhand
pinned: Would you shoot underhand if it made you a 90 percent free throw shooter, even if it looked silly?
